[SWS_CM_00710] No implicit context switches
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00203
⌈
When no
ReceiveHandler
has been set at the proxy side via
SetReceiverHan-
dler()
, new SampleData shall only be received by directly invoking
GetNewSam-
ples()
(polling behavior). Reception of new events itself shall not lead to an implicit
context switch in the local receiver process (i.e. if only polling behavior is used). In
case a
SetReceiveHandler()
is enabled, a context switch shall be enforced with
the reception of new events to schedule/invoke the
ReceiveHandler
.
⌋
